name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard captures the commanded 'open the door'; the soft Response(door_open, target_picked_up) captures 'if possible, pick up the box' as a preference, with the 'after opening the door' timing. The soft clause forces nothing, so no other Existence is needed and no goal is missing.

texts: If possible, pick up the box in the other room after opening the door.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u1) -> 6
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
